title: What a Waste 3.0: Country dataset (March 2026)
citation: Suggested citation: Cook, Ed, Ionkova, Kremena, Bhada-Tata, Perinaz, Yadav, Sonakshi, and Van Woerden, Frank. 2026. What a Waste 3.0: Global Snapshot of Solid Waste Management Toward Circularity until 2050. Country dataset (Excel). Washington, DC: World Bank Group.
sourceNotes: Note: The Country dataset tab includes data for 217 countries and economies collected during the research for What a Waste 3.0 in its original or partially harmonized format. Projections for 2022 to enable comparability in consistent year are provided, along with projections for 2030, 2040, and 2050. The Codebook tab includes all sources/references and notes for the data provided in the Country dataset; please refer to it for more information. All sources were collected between July 2024 and December 2025. Where date of measurement is not available, the year reflects either the year of publication of the source or the latest year for which the information remains applicable (as of 2026).

source.methodNotes: Only material presented at regulated facilities is counted, which means waste generation may be understated in some cases. To derive a national picture on waste, a common set of assumptions and categories must be applied to the collected data, based on the Australian Standard for Waste and Resource Recovery Data and Reporting. Some manipulation of state and territory data is required, including re-categorisation, applying assumed compositional splits and adjusting for cross-border transport.  Different territories measure their waste in different ways
